patch.value:
Source: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1467

## Summary and scope
A pre-existing discovery-contract gap remains in exact v2026.10.14 source `2024387a346bb88e0590e07cb3262e03307b997b`: optional extension flag values are correctly described by JSON help, but `contracts.command_flags[].flag_invocations` marks them required. This is not a newly introduced 10.14 regression.

**The new result is an exact-source integration probe, not published-10.14 artifact acceptance.** Official npm retrieval was unavailable. Actual installed 10.13 supplies the runtime control; no mutating action ran.

## Minimal case
Register a harmless command with `flags: [{ long: "--maybe [label]" }]` and an echo handler returning context.options/context.args.

- New JSON-help summary: `long:"--maybe", takes_value:true, value_required:false, value_name:"label"`.
- New `runContracts({command:"contract probe",flagsOnly:true}, ...)` result: `flag_invocations` says **`value_required:true`** for `--maybe`.
- Bare `--maybe` is accepted and produces `maybe:true`; `--maybe label` produces the string. Verified on actual 10.13 and both old/new source compositions.
- Old contracts already said required and embedded the placeholder in the flag identity. 10.14 repairs that identity but still loses optional arity.

## Evidence
- [toExtensionFlagContract](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/2024387a346bb88e0590e07cb3262e03307b997b/src/sdk/cli-contracts/runtime-contracts.ts#L1219-L1259) carries the parsed canonical name/value name but omits the extension declaration's optionality.
- [Invocation enrichment](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/2024387a346bb88e0590e07cb3262e03307b997b/src/sdk/flag-invocation-contracts.ts#L714-L752) derives optionality from built-in name sets rather than that declaration.
- The public SDK `verifyCliFlagInvocationParity` reports one `value_required_mismatch` across a five-flag fixture. Correcting only this field in an in-memory control makes parity pass.
- The #1461 source integration case checks structured help, but does not compare this machine-contract projection.

The harness uses exact selected source modules with Node TypeScript erasure, real Commander, the full source invocation/contracts functions and existing 10.13 runtime dependencies. Source transformations are confined to isolated test modules. Baseline files remain byte-identical to their retained verified artifact, with isolated HOME/PM path, telemetry disabled and network denied.

## Acceptance proposal
Carry arity from the shared canonical extension declaration into machine contracts. Reuse the existing parity verifier against actual extension observations instead of adding a second optional-flag name list. Cover bare optional values, supplied values, required values, boolean switches, aliases and repeated values through help, contracts and dispatch. Confirm the same fixture on the published artifact before closure.

## Ownership
Focused all-status searches found no exact newer owner. Related completed work: #1461 / pm-gh1461 (inline flag identity/help normalization), #817 / pm-11phn1 (semantic invocation metadata), #507 / pm-9qcr (extension arity/recovery). This narrow residual mismatch does not reopen or negate those deliveries. No implementation is included.
